name: xgb_control_v1
purpose: Experimental control for Model 1 (Linear 298-49). Not one of the four proposed models and not the published ARMOR baseline.
class_weights: inverse frequency N / (K * n_k) computed from the 88 fitting cases only; applied as per-case sample weights

features.unit: one vector per documented case (distinct minutes of its approved event_associated windows)

majority_control: predicts the most frequent fitting class (ties: lowest class id)
seed_sd_meaning: Standard deviation across seeds measures training randomness only. It is not uncertainty across independent incidents.
